text:
Type: geometric jacquard throw blanket
Use: layering on an armchair, sofa or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: woven jacquard, reversible, fringed ends
Colors: white, black
Shape: rectangular throw, black diamond and triangle motifs on white, reversible pattern, twisted white fringe, medium weight
Feel: graphic, crisp, relaxed
Goes with: cognac leather, warm wood, black and white rugs; bohemian, Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Geometric Diamond Jacquard Reversible Throw Blanket, 50" x 60", Black / White
product.description: Made in Portugal, this throw features a modern geometric design. The bold color palette, artful fringe and jacquard pattern on the reverse side make it particularly beautiful when draped over the edge of a sofa or arm chair. 50"W x 60"L 50% cotton/50% acrylic Dry clean for best results. Can be washed on delicate cycle and line dried.
